title: Shari Explains
description: Law, politics, and world events. A little less confusing.
heroIntro: The context behind the news, the law behind the decisions, and the questions worth asking. Let’s figure it out together.
aboutIntro: I started Shari Explains to educate myself and others about the law. My interest in law and politics grew into a place to explore big questions—and share what I’m learning along the way.
